findings.title: usageId fallback not type/blank checked
findings.problem: apiCallId falls back to usage.accounting?.usageId without checking it is a non-blank string; a whitespace-only or non-string usageId with no apiCallId would become the request_id.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger: only a malformed Copilot record lacking apiCallId; the field is typed string upstream, so no realistic consumer effect today. Reachability read at the call site; no guard found.
findings.recommendation: const u = usage.accounting?.usageId; const apiCallId = usage.apiCallId || (typeof u === 'string' && u.trim() ? u.trim() : undefined);
